body:
2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Police advice for Rochdale fans after substance forced Co-op Live evacuation during Don Toliver show (Rochdale). Anyone who went to Sunday's Don Toliver concert and has since felt unwell should go to hospital, see their GP or call 101, Greater Manchester Police say.

Littleborough farm owner seeks permission for wellness retreat with sauna and hot tub (Littleborough). Owners of Happy Hideaway in Littleborough have applied for retrospective planning permission to keep their sauna and hot tub retreat on agricultural land.

Weather: Cloudy 6°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
